title: Automated Language Learning Companion
business: Language education platforms providing conversational practice to millions of students.
problem: High-fidelity conversational AI models are prohibitively expensive to deploy at scale for low-stakes practice sessions, leading to unsustainable operational overhead.
solution: GPT-Realtime Mini provides a cost-efficient alternative for real-time audio interaction, allowing platforms to maintain interactive, low-latency experiences while significantly reducing the token-based cost per session.
steps: Establish a WebSocket connection to the v1/realtime endpoint using the gpt-realtime-mini model ID.
Configure the session to accept audio input and stream audio output for natural turn-taking.
Implement prompt caching for recurring instructional system prompts to lower input token costs.
Define function calling schemas to allow the model to trigger external vocabulary lookup tools during conversation.
outcome: Platforms can offer persistent, high-frequency conversational practice to a broader user base without compromising the responsiveness required for effective language acquisition.
limitation: The model has a 4,096 max output token limit, which may truncate long-form explanations; developers should monitor the output token count per turn to ensure responses remain within bounds.
